title: CAN LLMS RANK? A TALE OF TRIADS AND TRIAGE
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical assessment of consistency and reliability metrics (coefficient of consistency and Kendall's tau) for LLM-based rankings. While the application domains (medical triage and homelessness services) involve high-stakes ethical resource allocation, the paper's primary contribution is a diagnostic framework for measuring decision consistency rather than benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning systems.
